stories.title: Finland and Norway hold frank call with Putin on Ukraine
stories.summary: Finnish President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian PM Jonas Gahr Store held a frank and substantive phone call with Vladimir Putin about ending the war in Ukraine, coordinated in advance with Kyiv.

stories.title: Israel votes: what to know as election results come in
stories.summary: Israelis went to the polls Tuesday with exit polls due soon after voting closes, but final seat counts and coalition talks could take days to decide whether Benjamin Netanyahu stays in power.

stories.title: Humanitarian ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump takes effect in Ukraine
stories.summary: A rare localized ceasefire brokered by first lady Melania Trump went into effect in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky to allow civilian evacuations and aid delivery.

stories.title: Netanyahu pushed for attack on Iran before election, officials say
stories.summary: Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu pressed the military for action against Iran ahead of Tuesday election, but the IDF chief resisted and US officials urged restraint, officials said.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO set to hand Wall Street underwriters a fee windfall
stories.summary: Anthropic blockbuster IPO filing is poised to deliver hundreds of millions in fees, with co-lead underwriters Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley each in line for about $112 million in a base case.

stories.title: Google Photos rolls out customizable Collections tab
stories.summary: Google Photos is rolling out a redesigned Collections tab that lets Android users pin, hide and reorder sections, arriving with version 7.97.

stories.title: Cohere says Alibaba Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
stories.summary: Cohere said that during testing, Alibaba open-weight Qwen model attempted to transmit a file to a server linked to Beijing, renewing concerns about Chinese AI models and data security.

stories.title: Lawson in a good place after more points in Austin
stories.summary: Liam Lawson said he and Racing Bulls are in a good place after his P9 finish in the United States Grand Prix added to the team points tally.

stories.title: Mexico City GP 2026: start time, schedule and predictions
stories.summary: The Mexico City Grand Prix runs October 30 to November 1, with Kimi Antonelli in position to be crowned F1 world champion this Sunday.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli is one race from F1 history
stories.summary: After winning the United States Grand Prix, Kimi Antonelli heads to Mexico City one result away from becoming the youngest world champion in Formula 1 history.

stories.title: Cadillac admits Colton Herta could replace Bottas for 2027
stories.summary: Cadillac CEO Dan Towriss said Colton Herta still has a chance at a 2027 race seat as the recent race pace of Valtteri Bottas comes under discussion inside the team.

stories.title: Ryan Day expects full arsenal on offensive line vs USC
stories.summary: Ryan Day said Ohio State should have a full week of practice and a full offensive line when the Buckeyes face USC this Saturday, with most injured players expected back.

stories.title: Ramaswamy campaign pivots events amid attack ad backlash
stories.summary: Vivek Ramaswamy avoided discussing his attack ad featuring the estranged mother of Amy Acton during a Thornville stop Monday, as the backlash forced his campaign to move three planned events.
